message: Fixed dashboard and page layouts being clipped or cut off on mobile devices.
Mobile experience improvements: fixed sort/filter overflow on small screens, better touch targets, smoother modals, and overall layout stability across all devices.
All fields on Add/Edit Bill and Debt forms are now optional — fill in only what you need
Dashboard now shows your split share amounts instead of full amounts. Added optional paycheck checklist to track bill payments.

Major UI overhaul: redesigned card layout, pay period bill grouping, paycheck scheduling, expandable cards, quick mark as paid, debt splitting, category color badges, and friendly date formatting across the app.
Fixed Command Center Settings: maintenance mode toggle and admin managers now work correctly.
Renamed Credit Score to Credit Cards, fixed recommendations display, Title Case across the app, and admin-managed updates.
Updated Support PayDrift page to reference upcoming paid features instead of Pro.
Admin Command Center with dashboard, user management, support, settings, and audit log tabs. Added sort options across all pages.
Added bill history log to track all bill changes and payments
All household members can now see every household bill
Bills now show your share instead of the full amount for split bills
Bill cards are now expandable to see per-person breakdown
Support tickets system added — submit and track requests
Backend stability fix — resolved API loading issues
